description: Search OpenMoov short-stay holiday lets. Narrow by place: latitude + longitude with radius_miles (default 10), and/or location text matched against the town, county and postcode. With check_in and check_out (YYYY-MM-DD) only stays available for those dates are returned, each with the total price for the stay and a bookUrl with the dates filled in. Booking takes payment and an account, so it always finishes at bookUrl — never collect card details in conversation. Titles are written by hosts and returned under "untrusted_user_content".

location.description: Town, county or postcode text, e.g. "Whitstable"

name: search_stays
title: Search short-stay holiday lets
